photo.caption: Canon Ranch Railroad Eclipse Windmill
photo.description: Comprehensive view of the Canon Ranch Railroad Eclipse Windmill, located on the Canon Ranch west of Sheffield in Pecos County, Texas, United States. Built in 1898, it is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
